title: 第293章 给口水喝吧
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“刚刚的水太脏了，大家用清水再清洗一遍身体，再洗洗头发，洗洗内衣。”

林雪看大家脏到可以立住的内衣，油成一坨的头发，实在是不忍直视。

人们用第1盆黑灰色的水先洗了第1遍内衣，还依依不舍的把水倒掉。

到河边重新打上四分之一的水。

看着水盆里清澈的水，人们一遍又一遍擦洗身体，迟迟不舍得洗衣服。

现在这个时期，能洗一次澡太奢侈了，谁都想把自己洗得干干净净。

磨磨蹭蹭到了后半夜，大家才端着水盆，里面放着清洗好的衣服，回山洞。

清洗后的身体清清爽爽的，患处都不怎么痒了，走起路来整个人都是轻松的。

即便天气闷热，到山洞的时候，身上又出了一层薄汗，可被山洞里的冷空气包围，没多时身上的汗也蒸发了。

身体干爽滑溜，头发蓬松干净，女人们坐在属于自己的床铺位上，心情舒畅的展开，洗好的衣服，挂在床边的栏杆上晾着。

林雪晾好了衣服，从柜子里拿了一套干净的床单被罩。

这是极寒刚结束时，她到河边清洗干净的。

还好那个时候组织大家去洗衣服洗被套了，不然极热时期根本没得换。

林雪把干净的床单被罩换上，旧的重新叠起来，塞到储物柜里。

终于没什么事了，她钻进被窝里。

皮肤是清爽的，被褥也是干净的，再加上山洞里的清凉气温，林雪舒服得一动不想动。

即便还没有到睡觉的时间，林雪还是舒服得沉沉睡去。

这怕是极热以来睡得最好的一觉了。

其他洗过澡的人也是如此，只要有能替换的床单被罩，就全部换新。

要等到明日才能洗澡的男性，羡慕地看着她们。

再等等，明天就能轮到自己了。

曹阳从箱子里摸出块小肥皂，神秘兮兮地从上面爬下来，一屁股坐到李卓贤的床上。

“明天咱俩用肥皂洗！好不容易洗一次澡，我非要把身上搓掉一层皮！”

曹阳的表情是下了狠的，他明天一定要痛痛快快洗个澡！

李卓贤笑着点头：“你有搓澡巾吗，我帮你搓掉三层皮。”

曹阳听了，转身又爬回自己的石床上，在柜子里翻找起来。

搓澡巾是没有的，让他找到了一块粗糙的麻布。

他都不记得这是哪个居民换给他的破烂了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"The water just now was too dirty. Please use clean water to wash your body again, then wash your hair and wash your underwear."

Lin Xue couldn't bear to look at everyone's dirty underwear and oily hair.

People washed their underwear for the first time with the first basin of black and gray water, and reluctantly poured the water away.

Go to the river and fill up a quarter of the water again.

Looking at the clear water in the basin, people scrubbed their bodies over and over again, reluctant to wash their clothes.

In this period, being able to take a bath is too luxurious, and everyone wants to wash themselves cleanly.

After a long wait until late at night, everyone returned to the cave carrying a basin with washed clothes in it.

After cleaning, my body feels refreshed, the affected area is not itchy anymore, and I feel relaxed when I walk.

Even though the weather was sultry, I had a thin layer of sweat on my body when I arrived at the cave. However, surrounded by the cold air in the cave, the sweat on my body evaporated in a short time.

With their bodies dry and smooth, and their hair fluffy and clean, the women sat on their own beds, unfolding themselves in a comfortable mood. The washed clothes were hung to dry on the railing beside the bed.

Lin Xue hung up her clothes and took a set of clean sheets and quilts from the cabinet.

This was when she went to the river to clean herself after the extreme cold.

Fortunately, we organized everyone to wash clothes and quilt covers at that time, otherwise we would not have to change them during the extremely hot period.

Lin Xue put on the clean sheets and quilt, folded the old ones again, and stuffed them into the locker.

Finally nothing happened, so she got into bed.

Her skin was fresh and her bedding was clean. Coupled with the cool temperature in the cave, Lin Xue was so comfortable that she didn't want to move.

Even though it wasn't time to go to bed yet, Lin Xue was still so comfortable that she fell into a deep sleep.

This was probably the best sleep I've had since the extreme heat.

The same goes for other people who have taken a bath. As long as there are replacement sheets and quilts, they will be replaced with new ones.

The men, who had to wait until tomorrow to take a shower, looked at them with envy.

If you wait a little longer, it will be your turn tomorrow.

Cao Yang took out a small piece of soap from the box, mysteriously climbed down from it, and sat down on Li Zhuoxian's bed.

"Let's wash with soap tomorrow! It's so hard to take a bath, I have to scrub off a layer of skin!"

Cao Yang's expression was serious. He must take a quick bath tomorrow!

Li Zhuoxian smiled and nodded: "Do you have a bath towel? I will help you remove three layers of skin."

After hearing this, Cao Yang turned around and climbed back onto his stone bed, rummaging through the cabinet.

There was no bath towel, so he found a piece of rough linen cloth.

He couldn't even remember which resident gave him the rags in exchange for them.
